text:
devon: Heads up — seeing a 15-25% P99 latency regression on mistral-8x7b after the recent kernel-selector change. Regression shows up only for long contexts (>4k).

maria: ugh, saw that in CI traces too. short contexts look fine. timeline?

devon: Root message at 11:07. Repro steps I used: `./bench --model mistral-8x7b --seq 8192 --batch 1 --iter 200 --kv rolling` on a T4. Perf numbers attached below.

perf-bot: PROFILES: 
`seq=512  p50=22ms  p95=48ms  p99=68ms`
`seq=4096 p50=110ms p95=230ms p99=320ms`
`seq=8192 p50=260ms p95=540ms p99=820ms`
(After kernel-selector v2.3 update, baseline p99@8192 was ~650ms)

ajay: quick hypothesis: selector started choosing the fused sliding-window kernel that has not been tuned for 8x7b head/kv dims, maybe poor memory layout for KV concat.

linh: also noticed attention mask handling differs between kernels — some kernels expect `max_position_embeddings` clamp, others accept long rolling KV. If mask creation is inconsistent we might be zeroing wrong blocks.

maria: can you dump the kernel choices for the failing runs? and the kernel version?

devon: yes: run log snippet: 
```
[11:07:12] kernel-selector: chosen=fused_sw_attention_v1 (flags: sliding_window, qkv_split)
[11:07:12] runtime: kernel-version=nv_0.9.12
[11:07:12] kv-mode=rolling
[11:07:12] rope-scale=1.0
```

perf-bot: attached microprofile: `cpu_cycles` and `sm_efficiency` show big jumps inside attention GEMM when seq>4k. Memory stalls increase ~2.3x.

ajay: important detail: 8x7b has 8 heads grouped as 8*? but kv dim packing doesn't align with the fused kernel's expected 64-byte lanes. Mismatch -> extra copies.

linh: i'd try two immediate mitigations: (1) force kernel fallback to legacy_attention for seq>4096, (2) try rope_scale=0.5 experiment (we saw rope scaling affect cache reuse patterns earlier).

maria: rope_scale tweak? remind me how that changes runtime behavior.

ajay: rope_scale <1 compresses phase so longer contexts don't rotate as fast; runtime-wise it changes the numeric ops but also can change which kernel is chosen because the kernel selection considers sequence length *and* attention pattern heuristics.

devon: quick A/B: forced fallback patch applied in staging config: `kernel_policy.long_seq = legacy_attention`. Reran bench: 
`seq=8192 p99=670ms` (was 820ms). So fallback recovers most of regression.

perf-bot: legacy_attention run profile: memory_stalls down 30%, sm_efficiency back to baseline.

maria: fallback is good short-term. Need proper fix: either fix fused_sw_attention for 8x7b packing, or adjust selector heuristics.

ajay: i pushed a draft selector change that adds a `packs_ok` check: ensure (kv_dim % lane_width)==0 before choosing fused kernel. patch: 
```diff
- if (seq>1024 && supports_sw) select(fused_sw)
+ if (seq>1024 && supports_sw && (kv_dim % 32)==0) select(fused_sw)
```

linh: also found an attention-mask bug with padded batches: when padding tokens are contiguous end-of-sequence the fused_sw kernel expected an explicit causal mask length param. Without it it assumes full-length causal and does extra work, hurting perf. We should expose `effective_seq_len` to kernels.

devon: good call. Proposed quick change to runtime config: add `effective_seq_len` to request metadata (defaults to sequence length if unset). Example: 
```json
{"model":"mistral-8x7b","seq":8192,"effective_seq_len":5120,"kv_mode":"rolling"}
```

maria: that will let kernels skip extra rotations. Add a compatibility check so older kernels ignore it.

ajay: on the model-specific side, we should document an 8x7b tuning guide: recommended `kv_packing=32`, `rope_scale` default 1.0 but test 0.7 for >6k contexts, and `max_position_embeddings` clamp to 16384 in private deployments. Also call out that fused_sw kernels need aligned kv_dim.

devon: also flag: Mixtral/Qwen variants differ — Qwen uses interleaved qkv layout, so selector must consider layout (qkv_layout enum). I'll add that param to profiling harness.

perf-bot: new bench run after packs_ok selector and effective_seq_len set: 
`seq=8192 effective_seq_len=5120 p99=680ms` — stable and reproducible. CPU/GPU profiles show much reduced memcpy.

maria: action items:
- ajay: land packs_ok check + unit tests (selector)
- linh: add effective_seq_len field + attention-mask guards
- devon: run full perf sweep across 512/1k/4k/8k on T4/A10/4090 and post results to /perf-runs
- ops: disable selector v2.3 rollout until fixes propagate

devon: one more note — RoPE scaling side-effects: when rope_scale !=1.0 we must ensure evals (LLM quality) gating before changing defaults. For perf experiments ok to flip, but we need auto-eval hook in rollout pipeline.

maria: agreed. let's not change defaults until a pass from NLU team.

ajay: i'll open PR for packs_ok and a small microbenchmark that asserts no extra copies for aligned kv_dim. linking in PR in 10m.

linh: i'll add a tiny test where padded batch with effective_seq_len set gets zero extra work, test in both fused_sw and legacy kernels.

devon: thanks all. i'll post detailed run logs to the incident thread and mark this as blocker for the kernel-selector rollout. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: LOG LINK: https://perf.internal/runs/1749241234 (contains full profiles, flamegraphs, and harness commands)
